name: Rival shift/brake control pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed weight for the original Rival ten-speed left/right DoubleTap control pair: 320 g. The 2011 road catalogue supplies the mass, and SRAM’s exact-model service specification explicitly identifies its weight basis as a pair. Cable and housing inclusion is not stated.
